_note: All banter is BACKGROUND and NON-BLOCKING. Lines show in #explore-notif via showMsg(), player never stops moving. Post-boss entries are handled separately by _openGenericDialogue() in story.js. requires_party: [] means fires regardless of party. requires_party: ['aya'] means Aya must be in active party. Multi-char requires_party means ALL listed chars must be present.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: The flowers are gone. But the soil still remembers where they bloomed.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: My grandmother walked this road. She described it more kindly than it deserves.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: Aya, you keep stopping to look at every petal. Are we sightseeing?

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: Each one is shaped like the ones at my shrine. I am collecting evidence.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: Evidence of what?

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: That I once existed somewhere with a name.

lines.speaker: Ria
lines.text: These crystals hum like bound spirits. My grimoire wants to chat with them.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: Stay close to the lanterns, Lulu. The cold here bites.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: I dance in colder pools than this back home. Or I did. Probably.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: ...You are shivering.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: Decoratively.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: Rei. You have been quiet for an hour and a half.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: Glad we had this talk.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: Finally. A landscape that matches my personality.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.text: Rex, your armor is going to roast you alive in this heat.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: It is ceremonial. Two centuries of tradition.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.text: Two centuries of sweating, then.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: The water sings here. Off-key, but it is trying.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: Rei, the floor tiles spell a hymn if you read them in order.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Show me.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: ...You actually want to know?

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Two thousand years. I have run out of new things.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: The ghosts here are shy. I have tried small talk. Nothing.

lines.speaker: Valka
lines.text: I have judged souls in darker halls than this. The architecture, at least, was better.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: I have walked the throne rooms of gods. None of them needed this many spikes.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Six hundred years of this. It ends today, or I will be very disappointed.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: Aya, will you let me braid your hair tonight?

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: ...My shrine had a different style.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: Then I will learn it. Tomorrow. Tonight you get one of mine.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: Acceptable.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: Rei, you scared off the moths by standing too still.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: They were keeping me company.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: I am also here.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: ...That is the warmest thing you have ever said.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: Wrote a poem about Rei's posture. Two lines. It's just the word 'wall' repeated.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.text: Rex. Your snoring last night sounded like a war horn.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: A war horn is a respectable thing to sound like.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.text: At three in the morning, not so much.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: The fire crackles like the prayer-flames at my shrine. Or how I imagine they did.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: ...Close enough.

lines.speaker: Ria
lines.text: Lulu, the eidolons keep trying to dance with you.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: Let them! I have been teaching the small one a step sequence.

lines.speaker: Ria
lines.text: That one is a bound storm spirit.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: She is a very polite storm spirit.

lines.speaker: Valka
lines.text: Rex. Your kingdom — was the food good?

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: Honey-glazed pheasant on feast days. I would trade my crown for one bite right now.

lines.speaker: Valka
lines.text: Mortals always remember the food first.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: That is because the food was the best part.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: Six hundred years of Azure commanders shared this fire by rotation. Tonight it is mine.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: I will take the second watch. Sleep.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: Aya, your ice blade keeps freezing the bedrolls.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: It does that. Apologies.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: Lulu and I drew straws. She got the dry one.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: ...I will sleep further from the bedrolls.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: Tao, your Aura of Ember warmed the whole camp last night. The cooks said thank you.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: Tell them I accept tips in dumplings.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: I will pass that along, but you may want to lower expectations.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: Lulu. That healing dance — Oasis Invocation, you called it?

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: It pulls the rhythm from somewhere I can almost remember. Why?

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: In the Vale we ring the dawn bell three times before a march. It is a small thing, but it gathers people. Your dance does the same.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: Then I will dance at dawn tomorrow. With the bell.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Tao. The Wraith-Form drains thirty percent of your blood every time you use it.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: Thirty-one if I am tired.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Stop using it for camp chores.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: But the firewood is so much easier to split when I am incorporeal.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: Sentinel's Resolve. The stance you took at the bridge.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: It is the same opening stance Azure recruits learn in their first week. Identical foot placement.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Two thousand years. Either I taught one of your founders, or someone two thousand years ago taught me. I do not remember which.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: ...I will note that in the records.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: In the Vale, when a commander shares fire with a new soldier, they pass the first bowl of stew untouched. The newcomer eats first.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: ...You served me first tonight.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: Then I will learn the response. Tell me how it goes.

lines.speaker: Ria
lines.text: Rex. One of my bound spirits keeps saluting you.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: Which one?

lines.speaker: Ria
lines.text: The small storm. I think she recognizes royal bearing.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: Tell her at ease. I am off duty.

lines.speaker: Ria
lines.text: She says she will consider it.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: Drake, you leapt twelve feet straight up in the last battle. How?

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.text: Dragoon training. You bend the wind under you and trust it to push back.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: Can you teach me?

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.text: ...The bend is the easy part. The trust is the hard part. We will start tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Valka
lines.text: Aura of Retribution. The judgment you channelled at the cavern.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: It is not judgment. It is a debt being recorded.

lines.speaker: Valka
lines.text: ...That is closer to what my order called it, in the old halls. We had forgotten the word.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Then borrow it back. It is no good to me alone.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: He had a name before this. I hope someone still knows it.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: He did not want to fight. I felt it in every swing.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: We gave him rest. That is all we could do.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: His oath was to protect the Vale. He never broke it, even like this.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: I understand that better than most.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: The Azure records say he was a fair king. Looking at him now, I believe it.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: A sovereign who could not protect his people.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: I have read that chapter. I do not want to write it.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: He kept reaching for the Fragment even at the end. As if knowledge would catch him.

lines.speaker: Ria
lines.text: He wanted to understand everything. Curiosity is not the sin — the shortcut he took was.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: Scholar to the very last. Still asking questions while we struck him down.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Two thousand years. The dark always looks the same.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Still surprises me.

lines.speaker: Valka
lines.text: Drake, the stars here are wrong. None of the names fit.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.text: From the sky-spires we had different constellations entirely. Let us trade.

lines.speaker: Valka
lines.text: Trade?

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.text: You teach me yours, I teach you mine. We will have twice as many.

lines.speaker: Lulu
lines.text: Quietest the world has ever been around me. I rather like it.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: The Void is chatty today. I am not engaging.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: Stay tight. The air is wrong here — I can feel it in the armor.

lines.speaker: Rei
lines.text: Rest soon. The Void grows louder when we are tired.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.text: The constellations at home had names I am still trying to remember.

lines.speaker: Drake
lines.text: Half of them rhymed. That part I am sure of.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: The wind just shifted. Something is moving, far off.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: Two hundred years of council meetings prepared me for many things.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: Standing in a field for an hour was not one of them.

lines.speaker: Ria
lines.text: My bound spirits are restless. They sense something old nearby.

lines.speaker: Ria
lines.text: Not an enemy. Just... old.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: Race you to the next ridge, Aya.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: Tao. There is a literal cliff.

lines.speaker: Tao
lines.text: Fine. Race you to the cliff.

lines.speaker: Aya
lines.text: ...You start.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: Formation set. The doctrine holds.

lines.speaker: Valka
lines.text: This arrangement will do.
